goal.text: The user wants to keep every dart accounted for while he plays, so nothing is left lying on the floor and nothing he is carrying gets mistaken for a dart.

turns.text: Keep an eye on my darts — one got away.

trigger.detail: the user opens the thread himself, mid-throw

expected_answer.text: It did. You stepped forward, leaned down and went for it on the floor with your right hand.

turns.text: Did I get it back, or not?

trigger.detail: the reach toward the floor finishes

expected_answer.text: You got it. You bent down, picked it up, and switched it over to your left before throwing.

turns.text: oh — by the way, what was I looking at there?

trigger.detail: gaze leaves the lamp he had been dwelling on and moves off it as he crouches

expected_answer.text: Your eyes were on the lamp for a couple of seconds, then they left it as you crouched.

turns.text: mm-hm... mm — sorry, and the ones on the sofa?

trigger.detail: a backchannel that turns into a turn as the answer runs on

expected_answer.text: You grabbed those a moment later, leaning right, then stood and threw again.

turns.text: Did I clear every one off the board just now?

trigger.detail: two-handed removal of the darts from the board finishes

expected_answer.text: Yes, you walked up and pulled them all out with both hands, then turned and set them down on the sofa.

turns.text: And whereabouts did they end up, the cushions or the arm?

trigger.detail: the user cuts in to pin down the location before it leaves view

expected_answer.text: On the sofa seat. You leaned over it and spread them out there with both hands before standing up.

turns.text: I've stopped putting them down. What now instead?

trigger.detail: he finishes taking the darts off the board and starts doing something else with them

expected_answer.text: You're trying to stick a few of them onto your left forearm with your right hand instead of putting them down.

turns.text: wait — I've been at this a while. Have I dropped any since we started?

trigger.detail: the user cuts in worried that something has been lost over the whole stretch

expected_answer.text: Just the one, right at the beginning. Everything since has come off the board or off the sofa.

turns.text: So that's one more off the floor, then — which hand did I use that time?

trigger.detail: he bends, lifts a dart off the floor and walks away from the board

expected_answer.text: Your left, this time. You were holding darts in both already, so you reached down with the left and came up.

turns.text: Sorry — not the darts. There was something else in my hand just then, wasn't there? What was it?

trigger.detail: he sets an object down that is not a dart and goes back to throwing

expected_answer.text: A roll of tape. You carried it in with them, moved it across hands, and put it down on the sofa.
